card.name: Word start before -man/-men endings
card.fires_on: The piece just before a word continuing with "man" or "men", such as "Man" in "Manually", or compound stems like "snow", "states", "business" before "men".

modes.label: Manually
modes.description: Capital "Man" starting the word "Manually" at the start of a sentence or step.
modes.example: << Man>>ually selecting best bets for those 7

modes.label: Compounds ending in -men
modes.description: Stem of a compound that will end in "men" (snowmen, statesmen, clergymen, businessmen).
modes.example: a body of eight<< states>>men into whose hands he had committed all

modes.label: Other -man words
modes.description: Piece before "man" in words like bogeyman or mantras.
modes.example: radical bog<<ey>>man influences on Barack Obama

card.writes: It lowers the chance of the next piece being "man" in any form, and slightly favors "Men" words in other languages.
card.plain: It fires on the part of a word just before it turns into "man", "men" or "manu-", like "Manually" or "snowmen".
